title: Alert for Palm Hill Residents
summary: Be cautious; two young adults were seen near electric skateboards and with lit hats around your neighborhood early this morning. Lock vehicles and remove keys.
_summary_source_original: Just alerting our Palm Hill neighbors - 2 young adults were on what looked like electric skateboards early this morning - they appeared to have hats with lights on, and they were looking into lanai's and between houses. These photos are on Royal Palm across from overflow parking and the intersection of Sago Palm. Please make sure that your vehicles are locked and keys are removed.
